subject: DPA negotiation — deployment sovereignty options & signing workflow
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluepoint.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: BluePoint Legal <contracts@bluepoint.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redline and deployment-mode questions

Evelyn —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call last week. Attached is our internal redline to Redwood's standard DPA (BluePoint_DPA_Redline_v3.pdf). A few items we'd like clarified before we proceed to signature:

- Data residency & routing: our security team needs explicit handling for Dedicated (Redwood-managed GPU pool) vs Private/VPC (customer-managed networking). Please call out what telemetry or logs may leave the VPC in each mode.
- Subprocessors: we need an updated subprocessor matrix and a clear process for approval/opt-out for Dedicated deployments.
- Cross-border transfers: we prefer standard SCCs or an equivalent mechanism for transfers outside the EU.

Can you confirm who our primary Redwood contacts are for the SOC2 evidence and the subprocessor list? We'd like to get a narrow set of outstanding items addressed this week.

Attachments: BluePoint_DPA_Redline_v3.pdf (redline), deployment-diagram.png (your architecture from the call)

Best,
Olivia Chen
Contracts Manager — BluePoint Systems
contracts@bluepoint.com


From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluepoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, BluePoint Legal <contracts@bluepoint.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redline and deployment-mode questions

Olivia —

Thanks for the redline and diagram, appreciate the clarity. We'll review and propose a short set of targeted edits that preserve both parties' operational needs. Quick notes up front:

- Dedicated vs Private: operationally we can support both flows. For Private (VPC/on-prem) the customer controls ingress/egress and we do not have a path to read request payloads; for Dedicated (Redwood-managed) we run on isolated GPU pools but some control-plane metadata (request IDs, anonymized metrics) will flow to Redwood for observability.
- Subprocessor discipline: we can provide a current subprocessor list and offer pre-notification + 14-day objection window for any Tier-1 subprocessor additions affecting Dedicated pools.
- Cross-border: happy to adopt SCCs where required and provide an EU data flow appendix.

I'll loop in our legal and security folks internally (cc'd) to confirm exact language. Can you confirm a single DocuSign flow works for BluePoint once redlines are agreed?

If it's helpful, we can do a 30-minute review call tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>

---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluepoint.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redline and deployment-mode questions
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: BluePoint Legal <contracts@bluepoint.com>

Evelyn here — please see BluePoint's redline attached. They want more explicit callouts for Dedicated vs Private and stricter subprocessor controls.

Action items for us:
- Marissa: commercial note — if we agree to a 14-day objection window for Tier-1 subprocessors on Dedicated, what does that mean for committed capacity and timeline? Any commercial levers to propose?
- Karthik: legal/product — suggest exact clause language to add re: control-plane metadata and definition of "no access" for Private/VPC. Also review proposed subprocessor approval workflow.
- Mina: security — confirm what SOC2 artifacts + penetration test reports we can share, and whether we can provide a sanitized subprocessor security summary for BluePoint.

Proposed quick positions (for discussion):
1) Subprocessors: provide current list + 14-day notice for Tier-1 changes; allow customer to request mitigation or temporary suspension of Dedicated placement if the new subprocessor materially impacts compliance (we can proxy to a compatible pool).
2) Data routing: add a short appendix that defines telemetry categories allowed in Dedicated (anonymized metrics, request IDs) and confirm Private/VPC has no payload egress.
3) Signing: sign via DocuSign once we exchange the final redline + security checklist.

I attached a short Redline_Summary_EH.pdf that highlights suggested edits — please add comments inline and I'll consolidate.

-Evelyn

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluepoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, BluePoint Legal <contracts@bluepoint.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redline and deployment-mode questions — proposed compromise + signing link

Olivia —

Thanks again for the redline. Attached is our consolidated counterproposal (Redline_Summary_EH.pdf) with three pragmatic edits that should resolve your outstanding items quickly:

1) Subprocessor process: we will provide the current subprocessor matrix up front and commit to a 14-calendar-day notification window for Tier-1 subprocessor additions that could impact Dedicated pools. BluePoint may raise a written objection; if unresolved we will offer (i) temporary placement to a compatible pool or (ii) a rollback to Private/VPC for the affected workloads while we remediate.

2) Deployment appendix: added a short appendix that explicitly states: Private/VPC = no Redwood access to request payloads or user data; Dedicated = isolated Redwood-managed pools where minimal anonymized telemetry and request identifiers flow for SLO/debugging.

3) Cross-border transfers: where SCCs are required we'll attach an EU data flow schedule and include a standard transfer mechanism clause.

If those items look good we prepared a DocuSign envelope for the final DPA (link below). Please sign and we'll countersign.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning?doc=BP-2026-0482
Attachments: Redline_Summary_EH.pdf, deployment-diagram.png

Next steps we propose after signature:
- Security exchange: Mina will send the SOC2 package + sanitized subprocessor security summary inside our secure share.
- Ops: we'll create a migration plan for any teams you want on Dedicated vs Private and list expected timeline for dataset onboarding.

Can you confirm signing timeline? We'll hold the envelope open until EOD Friday PST.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@bluepoint.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: BluePoint Legal <contracts@bluepoint.com>, BluePoint Security <security@bluepoint.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Evelyn / team —

Thanks — BluePoint Legal reviewed your counterproposal and the language looks acceptable. I have signed via DocuSign and attached the executed copy (Signed_DPA_BP-2026-0482.pdf). Our security team reviewed the deployment appendix and asked one minor clarification which we've noted inline in the signed PDF (non-blocking).

Next: please send the SOC2 package and the sanitized subprocessor security summary to security@bluepoint.com (Mina, cc'd). We'll kick off procurement once we receive those artifacts.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Olivia Chen
Contracts Manager — BluePoint Systems

Attachments: Signed_DPA_BP-2026-0482.pdf
